headline: Top five Indian IT companies add 13,918 employees in the second quarter
hook: IT hiring picks up after quarters of stagnation
summary: India's top five IT services firms—TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, Wipro, and Tech Mahindra—collectively added 13,918 employees in the second quarter of the financial year. This growth follows multiple quarters of declining or stagnant headcount as companies grappled with macroeconomic uncertainties and cautious client spending. The net addition indicates a gradual recovery in demand and improved capacity building across the domestic technology sector. For Indian retail investors, this signals stabilizing business operations in the bellwether IT sector, potentially supporting long-term earnings growth.
whats_next: Q3 hiring trends and upcoming quarterly earnings reports
why_it_matters: IT sector earnings visibility improves as hiring rebounds.
winners_losers: IT employees gain / cautious investors reassured

Indian tech majors are positioning AI agent management as a core offering to expand client engagements.
